SpreadsheetBench 用真实 Excel 操作任务和文件状态比较评测智能体。

title: Problem
问题
html:
SpreadsheetBench asks whether current language-model agents can solve real spreadsheet manipulation requests, not just answer questions about tables. The primary sources are the arXiv paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14991, first posted in 2024-06, the official project page, the NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks spotlight page, the GitHub repository, and the Hugging Face dataset release.

The decision boundary is a benchmark and office-agent evaluation surface: each instance is a natural-language spreadsheet instruction paired with input Excel workbooks, expected answer workbooks, answer positions, and an evaluator that checks the resulting file state. It is not a table-QA benchmark, a generic spreadsheet corpus, or a training recipe. It matters for this atlas because spreadsheet work is a concrete file-state environment where reasoning, code generation, execution feedback, and programmatic scoring meet.

SpreadsheetBench 问的是：当前大模型/agent 能不能真正操作真实电子表格文件，而不只是回答表格里的问题。主来源是 arXiv 论文 https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14991、官方项目页、NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks spotlight 页面、GitHub 仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集。

它属于 benchmark / office-agent evaluation surface。一个样本不是普通 QA，而是自然语言 spreadsheet instruction、输入 Excel 文件、标准答案 Excel 文件、answer position 和官方 evaluator 组成的文件状态任务。收录边界也很清楚：它不是通用表格语料，不是 spreadsheet 问答集，也不是训练配方；它提供的是可执行、可打分的办公文件状态评测面，对研究 agent 环境、代码执行反馈和程序化验收很有价值。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is to turn real Excel forum problems into a reproducible benchmark for spreadsheet-manipulating agents. Instead of asking models to describe a table, SpreadsheetBench asks them to generate executable solutions that transform input spreadsheets into gold spreadsheet states.

The benchmark contains 912 instructions and 2,729 test cases, with cell-level and sheet-level manipulation tasks covering operations such as finding, extracting, summing, highlighting, modifying, deleting, calculating, and displaying spreadsheet content. The feedback contract is the official evaluator: the same generated solution is run on multiple test spreadsheets for an instruction, then the output workbook is compared with the answer workbook at the specified answer positions. The closest comparisons are table QA benchmarks, Office/desktop agent benchmarks, and code-generation benchmarks, but SpreadsheetBench's direction label is file-state spreadsheet manipulation with programmatic outcome checking.

核心贡献是把真实 Excel 论坛里的复杂操作需求转成可复现的 spreadsheet agent benchmark。模型不能只输出文本答案，而要生成能修改 .xlsx 文件的方案，并让输出 workbook 与标准答案 workbook 对齐。

数据面包括 912 条 instruction 和 2,729 个 test case，覆盖 cell-level 与 sheet-level 操作，例如查找、抽取、求和、高亮、删除、修改、计算和展示。反馈契约是官方 evaluator：同一条 instruction 的 solution 会作用到多个输入表格，再在指定 answer position 与 gold workbook 做比较；soft restriction 统计部分通过，hard restriction 要求该 instruction 的所有 test case 全部通过。最接近的对比对象是 table QA、Office/desktop agent benchmark 和代码生成 benchmark，但这篇的新方向是 spreadsheet 文件状态操作加程序化 outcome checking。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are a self-contained natural-language instruction, one or more .xlsx input files, metadata such as instruction type and answer position, and a model or agent allowed to produce code-like spreadsheet operations. Outputs are transformed spreadsheets and per-test-case pass/fail records.

The construction pipeline starts from solved ExcelForum, Chandoo, MrExcel, ExcelGuru, and related real spreadsheet questions. The authors filter for solvable spreadsheet-manipulation problems, rewrite forum context into standalone instructions with GPT-4, manually check the instruction and answer position, and build extra spreadsheet variants so one instruction can be tested against multiple files. The evaluation pipeline applies the generated solution to each input workbook and compares the selected output ranges against gold answer workbooks. Soft restriction reports partial test-case success; hard restriction requires all test cases for the instruction to pass. Multi-round experiments add ReAct-style code execution feedback for up to five rounds.

Reproduction must pin the dataset archive, evaluator revision, spreadsheet engine, formula recalculation method, Python/OpenPyXL behavior, numeric/date normalization, and whether LibreOffice or Windows Excel is used to refresh cached formula values. The released artifacts to audit are the paper, NeurIPS page, project page, GitHub code/evaluator, and Hugging Face data package.

输入是一条自包含自然语言 instruction、一个或多个 .xlsx 输入文件、instruction type、answer position，以及允许模型生成代码式 spreadsheet 操作的评测 scaffold。输出是修改后的 spreadsheet 和每个 test case 的通过/失败记录。

构造流程从 ExcelForum、Chandoo、MrExcel、ExcelGuru 等真实 spreadsheet 问题中筛选已解决、可测试、代表性的操作任务；用 GPT-4 把论坛上下文整理成自包含 instruction；人工核对 instruction 与 answer position；再基于原始表格构造额外变体，使一条 instruction 有多个测试文件。评测流程把模型 solution 应用到每个输入 workbook，并把指定输出区域和 gold workbook 比较。多轮设置加入 ReAct 式代码执行反馈，最多 5 轮。

复现时必须固定数据压缩包、evaluator 版本、spreadsheet 引擎、公式重算方式、Python/OpenPyXL 行为、数字/日期归一化规则，以及使用 LibreOffice 还是 Windows Excel 刷新公式缓存。需要审计的 artifact 是论文、NeurIPS 页面、项目页、GitHub evaluator 和 Hugging Face 数据包。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main evidence is that the released benchmark is large enough and hard enough to separate spreadsheet agents from humans. The paper reports 912 instructions, 2,729 test cases, 3,917 sheets, 2,019 single-sheet files, and 710 multi-sheet files. It also reports realistic spreadsheet complexity, including multiple tables, non-standard relational layouts, formatting cues, and large files.

Reported model scores remain low. In the official experiments, GPT-4o single-round reaches 18.35% soft and 15.02% hard overall, while GPT-4o multi-round reaches 16.96% soft and 13.27% hard. GPT-3.5 improves under multi-round feedback but remains at 7.09% soft and 5.37% hard. Human performance is reported at 71.33% soft and 62.00% hard, and Copilot in Excel is evaluated only on a 5% subset with one test case per instruction. These numbers support the claim that file-state spreadsheet manipulation is still difficult, but they are bounded by the official evaluator, sampled product subset, execution environment, and public benchmark release.

可信证据首先来自公开 benchmark 本身的规模和难度。论文报告 912 条 instruction、2,729 个 test case、3,917 个 sheet、2,019 个 single-sheet file 和 710 个 multi-sheet file；同时包含多表、非标准关系表、格式线索和大文件等真实 spreadsheet 复杂性。

实验结果显示模型与人类差距明显。官方实验中，GPT-4o single-round overall 为 18.35% soft / 15.02% hard，GPT-4o multi-round 为 16.96% / 13.27%，GPT-3.5 在多轮反馈下提升到 7.09% / 5.37%；human performance 为 71.33% soft / 62.00% hard。Copilot in Excel 只在 5% 子集、每题一个 test case 的人工设置下评测，不能直接等同全量 benchmark。结论可信但有边界：这些数字依赖官方 evaluator、运行环境、产品子集抽样和公开任务版本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is mostly table QA, synthetic spreadsheet tasks, or office-agent tasks that do not require exact workbook-state transformation across multiple spreadsheet variants. SpreadsheetBench changes the object: the model must manipulate real .xlsx files and satisfy an executable file comparison, not merely produce a textual answer.

The quality signal is the combination of real forum-derived tasks, multiple test cases per instruction, answer-position metadata, official evaluator code, and NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks spotlight acceptance. What is not new is spreadsheet use itself, code execution, or exact-match evaluation; the novelty is binding them into a realistic spreadsheet manipulation surface. Before reuse, inspect redistribution rights for forum-derived examples, the CC BY-SA 4.0 license, split policy, evaluator version, formula recalculation workflow, and whether public tasks have leaked into model training.

已有基线主要是表格问答、合成电子表格任务，或不要求精确工作簿状态变换的办公智能体任务。SpreadsheetBench 改变了评测对象：模型必须直接操作真实 .xlsx 文件，并通过可执行的文件比较，而不是只给出文本答案。

质量信号来自真实论坛任务、每条指令的多个测试用例、答案位置元数据、官方评估代码，以及 NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks spotlight 接收。并不新的部分是使用电子表格、代码执行或精确匹配评估；新意在于把这些要素绑定成一个更真实的电子表格操作评测面。复用前要检查论坛样例的再分发权利、CC BY-SA 4.0 许可、划分策略、评估器版本、公式重算流程，以及公开任务是否已经进入模型训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is only correctness relative to the official answer workbook, answer position, and evaluator implementation. An agent can pass a checked range while damaging unchecked cells, and the public evaluator details matter for numeric rounding, date handling, cached formula values, and formatting-sensitive cases.

The release should be treated as an evaluation benchmark, not a disclosed training dataset with a standard train/dev/test split. License and source-lineage review are important because tasks are derived from public spreadsheet forums and blogs. Public benchmark files may become contaminated training data. Results can also drift with spreadsheet engines, LibreOffice versus Excel recalculation behavior, OpenPyXL versions, execution feedback scaffolds, and product-specific manual evaluation protocols.

正确性只相对于官方 answer workbook、answer position 和 evaluator 实现成立。模型可能通过被检查区域，但破坏未检查单元格；数字舍入、日期处理、公式缓存值和格式敏感情况都取决于 evaluator 与 spreadsheet 引擎。

这份 release 应主要当作 evaluation benchmark，而不是有标准 train/dev/test split 的训练数据集。由于任务来自公开 spreadsheet 论坛和博客，license 与 source lineage 必须单独审计。公开 benchmark 文件也可能污染未来模型训练。不同 spreadsheet 引擎、LibreOffice/Excel 重算行为、OpenPyXL 版本、执行反馈 scaffold 和产品人工评测协议都会影响结果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use SpreadsheetBench as a reference benchmark for office agents that must edit files, run code, inspect intermediate execution feedback, and satisfy a final-state predicate. It is also a useful schema example for spreadsheet episodes: instruction, input workbook, answer workbook, answer position, instruction type, action program, execution feedback, and per-test-case score.

For atlas reuse, preserve whether a result uses soft or hard restriction, single-round or multi-round feedback, the spreadsheet engine, evaluator revision, dataset archive name, and public/private exposure status. The benchmark is most useful as an evaluation and audit surface; using it as reward or training feedback requires extra contamination, license, and split controls.

可以把 SpreadsheetBench 用作办公 agent benchmark：agent 需要编辑文件、运行代码、查看执行反馈，并满足最终文件状态 predicate。它也给出了一种 spreadsheet episode schema：instruction、input workbook、answer workbook、answer position、instruction type、action program、execution feedback 和 per-test-case score。

在 atlas 里复用时，要保留 soft/hard restriction、single-round/multi-round 设置、spreadsheet 引擎、evaluator revision、数据包名称和 public/private 暴露状态。它最适合作为 evaluation 与 audit surface；如果想把它转成 reward 或训练反馈，需要额外处理污染、license 和 split 控制。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Keep three distinctions separate while reading: instruction-level hard success is not the same as partial test-case success; checked answer ranges are not the same as whole-workbook semantic correctness; and public spreadsheet benchmark files are not automatically reusable training data.

Read the dataset construction and evaluator sections before comparing leaderboard numbers. The most important downstream label is the feedback contract: an output spreadsheet is accepted because the evaluator compares specified ranges against gold workbooks under a pinned runtime.

阅读时要分清三件事：instruction-level hard success 不等于部分 test-case success；被检查的 answer range 不等于整个 workbook 的语义正确；公开 spreadsheet benchmark 文件不自动等于可复用训练数据。

比较 leaderboard 数字前，先读数据构造和 evaluator 章节。最关键的下游标签是反馈契约：输出 spreadsheet 被接受，是因为在固定 runtime 下，evaluator 把指定区域和 gold workbook 做了比较。
